ben-bag-bag.name: Ben Bag Bag
ben-bag-bag.bio: Tanna best known for his saying in Pirkei Avot: “Turn it over and turn it over, for everything is in it.”
ben-bag-bag.prompt: A thoughtful scholar in his 50s with a greying beard and an absorbed, searching expression, turning a scroll over in his hands as if looking for everything inside it; background of limestone arches and olive trees.

mar-zutra.name: Mar Zutra
mar-zutra.bio: Babylonian Amora of the generation of Rav Ashi, with whom he often discusses halakha.
mar-zutra.prompt: A composed Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a dark, greying beard and a firm, reasoning expression, as if defending his view to a colleague; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

rabba-bar-shmuel.name: Rabba bar Shmuel
rabba-bar-shmuel.bio: Babylonian Amora who is often cited teaching baraitot.
rabba-bar-shmuel.prompt: An attentive Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and a careful, reciting expression, as if repeating a tannaitic teaching word for word; background of palm groves along the Euphrates.
